verdict.rationale: Gazebo is a robotics simulator: physics, rendering, sensors, plugins and simulation CLI tools. Pushing configuration to a deployed robot fleet with per-group targeting belongs to fleet-management or ops platforms, so this axis is outside its product category. Nothing in the evidence shows fleet-wide config push or group targeting. Transport messaging and config scripts serve simulation and process launching, not fleet operations.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can push configuration changes across many robots at once with per-group targeting
